verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents an API-key-authenticated REST API, and its built-in MCP server is claimed to 'drive the whole platform' (building flows, managing tables, testing automations). No document claims or shows full API-to-UI parity, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. API keys are generated in the platform dashboard rather than through the API. missing for 10: documented API/UI parity statement or full endpoint coverage, published OpenAPI spec, programmatic API key management, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The API uses "API keys" to authenticate requests.
you can pass the API key as a Bearer token in the header
Activepieces includes a built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables, test automations, and more
Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client and it drives the whole platform.
API keys are generated under the platform dashboard at this moment to manage multiple projects
